07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.

CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated May 24, 2012. (COUNCIL)

B.
Successor Agency dated May 24, 2012. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

City Council Regular Meeting of May 10, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the City Council Regular Meeting Minutes of May 10, 2012.
B.
Successor Agency Regular Meeting of May 10, 2012. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

9.
Ordinance for second reading and adoption. Reading of ordinance waived at introduction.
A.
ORDINANCE NO. 970 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 2.16 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO CHANGE THE REGULAR CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING FREQUENCY FROM TWO MEETINGS PER MONTH TO ONE MEETING PER MONTH WITH A SECOND MONTHLY MEETING ADDED ON AN AS-NEEDED BASIS. (COUNCIL)
waive reading of and adopt ORDINANCE NO. 970 entitled: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 2.16 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO CHANGE THE REGULAR CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING FREQUENCY FROM TWO MEETINGS PER MONTH TO ONE MEETING PER MONTH WITH A SECOND MONTHLY MEETING ADDED ON AN AS-NEEDED BASIS.
End of Consent Calendar
10.
Public Hearings
A.
An appeal of an action of the Cerritos Planning Commission approving a residential development proposal by the property owner to construct a first-floor addition and a new second floor to an existing, one-story residence at 12320 Elgers Street, Cerritos, California, 90703. The subject property is zoned single-family residential (RS-5000) (APN 7025-025-033). (COUNCIL) Precise Plan 2012-3* *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt.
deny the appeal and uphold the approval of the project by the Cerritos Planning Commission.
11.
Public Works Activities
A.
Consideration and award of contract for ongoing electrical maintenance for the City of Cerritos. (COUNCIL)
award contracts for ongoing electrical maintenance for the City of Cerritos to Harry W. Dantema of Cerritos; Sutton Electric of Mission Viejo; and Service 1st Contractors of Costa Mesa.
12.
New and Old Business
A.
A request by applicant Conant Properties V, L.P., 20322 Southwest Acacia Street, Suite 100, Newport Beach, California, 92660, for a time extension to previously approved Conditional Use Permit 2011-6 for an automobile reconditioning facility, which will include minor auto mechanical repair and detailing operations to prepare pre-owned automobiles for off-site sale in the Cerritos Auto Square. The property is located at 17720 Studebaker Road, Cerritos, California 90703, and is zoned Industrial/Commercial (MC) (APN 7034-016-037). (COUNCIL)
approve an 18-month time extension, ending on June 8, 2013, for Conditional Use Permit 2011-6, making the findings set forth in Resolution No. PC 2012-19.
B.
Consideration and award of contract for maintenance and re-patination of certain artwork located in the Cerritos Civic Center, generally located on the Northwest Corner of Bloomfield Avenue and 183rd Street (APN 7025-028-906 and 7025-028-908). (COUNCIL)
1. Find that contracting with national Sculptors’ Guild is in the best interest of the City, that dispensing with the bidding process satisfies the purposes of the purchasing ordinance of the Cerritos Municipal Code, and that it is reasonable and necessary to sole source the repatination of Amaryllis and the Dolphins;
2. Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with National Sculptors’ Guild for the proposed services in the amount of $19,000 for the Amaryllis sculptures and $9,750 for the Dolphin sculptures subject to the approval of the City Council; and
3. Authorize the expenditure of $5,000 to provide for the added costs per the bids for the City to support these projects.
13.

A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor’s Office for signature.
14.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
15.
Adjournment
